name: Love Goes Toward Love
source:
When a new cafe opens right in front of the one Chiyoda Juri works at, tensions begin to rise between the two competing owners. After a fateful encounter, Juri falls in love at first sight with the beautiful and charismatic stranger that saved her life—who just so happens to be the new worker at the rivalling cafe. To make matters worse, her savior already has eyes on someone else!

How will Juri deal with these overflowing feelings for someone she shouldn’t have feelings for? 

[From [url=https://teamanpim.itch.io/love-goes-toward-love]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
千代田Juri工作的咖啡馆正对面，开了一家新店，两位竞争店主之间的关系逐渐紧张。一次命运般的邂逅中，Juri对救下自己的美丽、富有魅力的陌生人一见钟情，而对方恰好是竞争咖啡馆的新员工。更糟的是，这位救命恩人已经另有所爱！

面对本不该产生感情的对象，以及满溢而出的心意，Juri会如何应对？

[摘自[url=https://teamanpim.itch.io/love-goes-toward-love]Itch.io[/url]]
